page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.large is a general-purpose virtual machine instance configured with 4 vCPUs and 16.0 GB of RAM. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz, the instance features 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled and a dedicated CPU allocation. The architecture is x86_64, supported by a 35 MB L3 cache. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations place the ecs.sn2.large in the lower performance tiers. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests via stress-ng and Geekbench categorize the instance in the bottom 10% to 25% of tested hardware. Memory bandwidth tests show similar limitations, with uncached read-only large block bandwidth measured at 21.24 GB/sec and write bandwidth at 18.69 GB/sec. Computational workloads such as gzip compression, bzip3 decompression, and Redis SET operations also register in the bottom 10% tier, reflecting modest processing throughput.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation paired with a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.sn2.large offers a predictable resource profile for entry-level workloads. However, its low benchmark-relative performance suggests a tradeoff where compute-intensive tasks will experience bottlenecking. It is best suited for lightweight general-purpose applications, basic web serving, small-scale database operations, or development and testing environments that require dedicated CPU resources without demanding high-throughput processing.
